items.text: Insurance Act passed, foundation of Indian insurance regulation.
LIC was formed and life insurance was nationalised.
IRDAI Act was passed to open up the sector.

cards.title: Utmost Good Faith
cards.content: Complete transparency between insurer and insured.

cards.title: Insurable Interest
cards.content: You must suffer a direct financial loss if the insured event happens.

cards.title: Indemnity
cards.content: Restores the insured to the same financial position as before the loss.

sections.title: Exam Pro-Tips
items: Always remember the grace period is 30 days for yearly/half-yearly premiums.
Free Look period is exactly 15 days from receipt of the policy document.
